The cost-benefit analysis failed due to incorrect margin calculations and program-level data mismatches in the final output.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_rows_and_order and test_totals_and_decision. Specifically, the program-level margin check failed with 'close(302.4, 4536.0)' returning False, and the aggregate 'total_annual_margin_10_day_usd' was calculated as -61983.9 instead of the expected -79751.7. While the script successfully generated a JSON structure that passed 3 of 5 sub-tests, the underlying logic for calculating annual margins or handling program codes requires correction.
